declarations.name: FoundationishAccordion
declarations.description: A progressively enhanced disclosure item. It enhances native details markup, light-DOM button and panel markup, or opt-in Shadow DOM templates.

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Controls the open state. When present, the component synchronizes aria-expanded and panel visibility, or the nested details element's open state.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Uses the default Shadow DOM template when present without a value, or clones the document template whose id is the attribute value.

attributes.name: shadowstyles
attributes.description: Adds Shadow DOM styles. Use the empty string or default for the component defaults, or provide a CSS URL.

events.name: accordion:before-toggle
events.description: Dispatched before an interaction toggles the expanded attribute.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ element: EventTarget; expanded: boolean; triggeredExternally: boolean }>

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Supplies the interactive trigger when using the default Shadow DOM template.

slots.name: panel
slots.description: Supplies the disclosure panel when using the default Shadow DOM template.

slots.name: trigger-label
slots.description: Supplies the default template trigger label.

slots.name: panel-content
slots.description: Supplies the default template panel content.

cssParts.name: disclosure
cssParts.description: The disclosure wrapper in the default template.

cssParts.name: trigger
cssParts.description: The trigger button in the default template.

cssParts.name: panel
cssParts.description: The panel in the default template.
